# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in PaperNym, please **do not** open a public issue.

Instead, please report it privately:
- Through GitHub's [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/jubayerprantor/PaperNym/security/advisories/new).
- Or by emailing the project maintainer directly.

Please include:
1. A description of the issue and potential impact.
2. Step-by-step reproduction instructions or a minimal proof of concept.
3. Your operating system and Python / PaperNym version.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you on a timely resolution and release.
